docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,500.00 FILED BY HEGEL, KEVIN AS TO DEFENDANT GOODRICH, NANCY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAR-16-2020 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
COPYING FEES (10 PAGE) PAID BY PLAINTIFF HEGEL, KEVIN
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF - (FEE FOR SERVICE: $75.00) SERVED FEB-04-2020, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT GOODRICH, NANCY

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-16-2020 - JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFF KEVIN HEGEL IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT NANCY GOODRICH IS PRESENT. VINCENT FAVALE AND MIGUEL CRUZ TESTIFY ON DEFENDANT'S BEHALF PLAINTIFF DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HEGEL, KEVIN IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT GOODRICH, NANCY COURT FINDS THERE SHOULD HAVE BEEN NO CHARGE FOR CLEANING GROUT IN KITCHEN DUE TO PRESENCE OF MOLD. COURT FINDS OTHER CHARGES AS DEDUCTIONS ARE CORRECT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED JUN-01-2020 ORDERED DESTROYED
